# Synthetic transaction fixtures

**These are NOT real cluster transactions.** Each `*.json` file here is a
*getTransaction-shaped* fixture generated by
[`scripts/gen-tx-fixtures.ts`](../../../scripts/gen-tx-fixtures.ts).

They are built from the real instruction builders and real borsh-encoded
`Program data:` event logs (manual layout: pubkeys 32 bytes, `u64`/`i64`
little-endian), so the byte layout matches what the program will emit. The
`transaction.message` is a real compiled legacy message serialized to base64,
and failed cases carry a synthetic `meta.err`.

They exist so the read-only indexer (`parseTransaction`, `classify`) can be
tested without a deployed program or network access.

Once the program is deployed to localnet, replace these with recorded
transactions (e.g. captured from `connection.getTransaction(sig)` during the
localnet E2E run). Keep the same filenames where possible.

Regenerate with:

```
pnpm gen:fixtures
```

Files:

| File | Case |
|---|---|
| `paid-exact.json` | successful `pay_invoice`, amount == amount_due |
| `overpaid.json` | successful `pay_invoice`, amount > amount_due |
| `failed-underpayment.json` | failed `pay_invoice`, `Underpayment` (6000) |
| `failed-expired.json` | failed `pay_invoice`, `InvoiceExpired` (6003) |
| `failed-invoice-mismatch.json` | failed `pay_invoice`, `InvoiceMismatch` (6022) |
| `double-pay.json` | failed `pay_invoice`, `DuplicatePayment` (6001) |
| `unattributed-transfer.json` | direct SPL transfer to escrow (no Paytruth instruction) |
| `not-a-payment.json` | unrelated System transfer |
